baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots join a plural rushing subject with an accusative breath/sound event.
baseline_models.mechanism: Before context, the most stable mechanism is embodied acceleration: movement is intense enough to become audible respiration, so the ayah is not static oath-labeling but a felt body in motion.

activation_trace.role: Running/hastening supplies the overt kinetic body and makes the subject a moving force.
Audible panting supplies the sound emitted by that force and turns motion into breath.
Extended running confirms that the sound belongs to exertive forward drive rather than detached noise.

changed_reading.before: The focus could be only an oath by running agents.
changed_reading.after: The focus becomes an acoustic-kinetic event: bodies rush until their breath itself is the sworn evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root inventory lets the rushing subject also carry overstepping, hostility, and crossing a limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same running root can be read socially and legally: haste is not neutral travel but a pressure that crosses a boundary and approaches an enemy relation.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping into injustice turns motion into boundary-violation and gives the rush an aggressive edge.
Enemy/enmity supplies a social target for the rush and prevents the motion from being merely athletic.
Panting makes the aggressive crossing bodily and urgent rather than abstract.

changed_reading.before: The runners may be read as fast but morally unmarked.
changed_reading.after: The runners become threshold-crossers: speed is already charged with aggression and hostile approach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second focus root includes scorched wood, darkening, and ash alongside breath; these stay anchored in the same focus word.
baseline_models.mechanism: A latent material reading sits under the audible one: panting can be accompanied by heat, blackening, or burnt residue, so the oath body has a combustion-shadow even before the later fire cue.

activation_trace.role: Scorched upper wood gives the focus sound a material heat-image that can later ignite into fire.
Darkening by fire or sun marks the body as visibly affected by heat, not only audibly strained.
Ash supplies the endpoint of the heat chain and keeps a residue-reading available.
Running/hastening remains the anchoring force that could generate the heat.

changed_reading.before: Panting is just breath from running.
changed_reading.after: Panting also opens a scorched-material register: exertion can be heard, heated, blackened, and left as residue.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of the first focus root admits counted readiness and repeated return as live but non-dominant shadows.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without leaving the focus, the rushing plural can be felt as prepared units or a repeated habit: not a single spontaneous burst, but an already readied, countable, recurring motion.

activation_trace.role: Prepared equipment/readiness recasts the runners as mustered force rather than raw motion.
Counting supplies plurality as countable units and opens a reckoning register.
Habitual return turns the rush into a repeated pattern that can diagnose settled disposition.
Panting keeps this prepared or repeated motion embodied in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The motion may seem immediate and singular.
changed_reading.after: The motion also hovers as mustered, countable, and habitual: a prepared rush that can recur as character.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next oath unit turns the focus from mere breath into a friction system: hidden fire is brought out by striking, so rushing bodies become converters of motion into spark.

activation_trace.role: Running/hastening supplies the kinetic input that can be converted into ignition.
Scorched material supplies the focus-side bridge from breath to heat.
Hidden fire emerging from a fire-stick supplies the latent energy that the focus motion can release.
Fire kindled by striking supplies the contact mechanism that revises panting into frictional production.

structural_cues: The first two oath units share feminine plural agents followed by accusative event nouns, making the second unit read as continuation of the first rather than an unrelated image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies rush, panting, hidden fire, and striking; I supply the arrow from kinetic contact to ignition. Live alternative: literal hoof-sparks without a broader combustion model.

changed_reading.before: The focus bodies merely run and pant.
changed_reading.after: The focus bodies run as frictional engines: breath, heat, and spark are one escalating mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The morning incursion cue strengthens the boundary-aggression baseline: the rush now arrives at a temporal threshold where darkness changes into visibility and hostile motion becomes an intrusion.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping into injustice anchors the rush as a boundary breach.
Enemy/enmity supplies the social field into which the rush enters.
Change or substitution supplies the threshold effect: the scene shifts state as the rush arrives.
First daylight supplies the time when hidden motion becomes visible exposure.
Morning arrival supplies the event-shape of an incursion at dawn.

structural_cues: The packet moves from fire-making to a named morning time, giving the rush a staged sequence from hidden energy to visible arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies change/otherness and morning arrival; I infer that dawn is a visibility-threshold that turns running into incursion. Live alternative: morning simply timestamps the same raid.

changed_reading.before: The focus rush is fast and possibly aggressive, but not yet placed in time.
changed_reading.after: The focus rush becomes threshold violence: panting pressure crosses into first light and makes aggression visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dust verse converts breath into environmental trace. Motion no longer vanishes as sound; it stirs a medium and leaves a visible, followable sign of passage.

activation_trace.role: Audible panting anchors the event as emitted trace from the moving body.
Running/hastening supplies the force that disturbs the ground.
Rising and outward spread supplies the dust-cloud expansion caused by the rush.
Stirring a thing from its place supplies the physical displacement mechanism.
A remaining mark supplies the evidentiary side of the same disturbance.
Raised dust supplies the visible medium in which the focus motion is preserved.

structural_cues: The repeated pronoun in the dust and center verses lets the earlier rushing/sparking event keep operating as the cause of later effects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies stirred spreading, a split-root mark, and raised dust; I infer that the dust functions as evidence left by the focus motion. Live alternative: dust is only scenic aftermath.

changed_reading.before: Panting is a transient sound of exertion.
changed_reading.after: Panting becomes the first trace in a chain of residues: sound is joined by dust, mark, and followable evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rush reaches not just a path but the interior of a gathered body. The focus boundary-crossing reading becomes spatially exact: it penetrates from edge to center and interrupts collective formation.

activation_trace.role: Passing beyond supplies the crossing from outside into an interior zone.
Side or edge supplies the starting boundary that the rush leaves behind.
Entering or making something central supplies the spatial endpoint of the rush.
An assembled group supplies the collective body that is breached.
Coming together for a purpose supplies social coordination that the rush disrupts.

structural_cues: The sequence from dust to center to gathering gives the focus motion a path: outside force, disturbed medium, then interior penetration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies center-entry and gathered group; I infer an outside-to-inside breach caused by the focus rush. Live alternative: the runners simply arrive among allies or a neutral crowd.

changed_reading.before: The focus rush may be directionless speed.
changed_reading.after: The focus rush becomes interior breach: it crosses an edge, enters the middle, and presses into a gathered collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The declarative human section does not cancel the rush; it turns the rush into a diagnostic image for human disposition. The same overdriven motion reappears as severance from the Lord, self-witness, and tight attachment to desired good.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping anchors the moral transfer from physical breach to relational breach.
Habitual recurrence lets the rush become character rather than one event.
Human appearance supplies the subject to whom the oath-scene is applied.
Lordship and ownership supply the violated relation against which the rush is judged.
Ingratitude for favor supplies the moral name for the boundary-crossing impulse.
Presence with witnessing supplies self-implicating evidence rather than external accusation only.
Heart-fast love supplies the inner attachment that drives the rush.
Desired benefit supplies the object toward which the appetite runs.
Binding or tightening supplies the mechanism by which love becomes hard compulsion.

structural_cues: After the oath-chain, repeated emphatic assertions shift from event description to diagnosis while retaining the same energy vocabulary through relation, witness, love, and severity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies human, Lord, ingratitude, witness, love, good, and tight severity; I infer that the oath-scene externalizes this inner drive. Live alternative: the oath merely introduces a separate moral proposition.

changed_reading.before: The focus rush belongs to external charging bodies.
changed_reading.after: The focus rush also images human appetite: a habitual overdrive that cuts gratitude and tightens around desired good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final disclosure sequence reverses the focus scene. What began as outward rush, breath, dust, and surface force becomes the uncovering of what was buried and what issued from the chest.

activation_trace.role: Passing beyond anchors the transition from surface motion to crossing into hidden interiors.
Breath anchors the inner bodily register that later disclosure can expose.
Disclosure to knowledge supplies the cognitive endpoint of the trace.
Turning earth and exposing what was buried supplies the ground-level reversal of the earlier dust.
Hiddenness and sinking supply what the earlier rush could not itself reveal.
Extracting the precious inner part from a covering supplies the interiorizing counterpart to raised dust.
The origin from which acts issue supplies the moral source behind the rush.
Knowledge of inner matter supplies final inspection of the hidden motive.

structural_cues: The late passive verbs of uncovering and collecting answer the early active rush: the scene turns from agents doing things to hidden things being exposed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies knowledge, graves, turned earth, extraction, chests, and inner expertise; I infer a reversal from outward kinetic traces to inward forensic disclosure. Live alternative: the final verses are only eschatological sequel, not a rereading of the focus.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an outward scene of rushing bodies and panting breath.
changed_reading.after: The focus becomes a surface symptom whose full truth is revealed only when buried ground and chest-origins are turned inside out.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it moves from warlike panting to sickness; valid because the focus breath root anchors it and the packet supplies lung/interior and chest disclosure. Downstream prose should mark it as a bodily-shadow, not the primary reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus breath/sound can be heard as an interior bodily emission rather than only exertive noise.

activation_trace.role: Panting supplies the audible breath that can become symptom.
A consuming lung or inward disease supplies the pathological interior shadow of breath.
The chest as organ locates the breath-shadow inside the body.
Knowledge of inner matter contains the symptom as something inspected, not merely heard.

changed_reading.before: The panting is the healthy noise of speed.
changed_reading.after: The panting can also flicker as an inner consumption made audible before it is exposed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it leans on non-dominant split mappings of the focus root and on gaming/counting imagery; valid because those mapped roots are in the focus inventory and later gathering/extraction cues activate reckoning. Render only as a latent administrative shadow of the rush.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The first focus root's split inventory allows readiness, countability, and repeated return to coexist beneath the overt runners.

activation_trace.role: Prepared equipment recasts the rush as mustered and already arranged.
Counting supplies the possibility that the plural is a numbered set under reckoning.
Habitual repetition makes the prepared rush recur as a settled pattern.
Lots or arrow-staves supply a risky counting device that can reframe the rush as apportioned outcome.
Gathering scattered things supplies the collecting operation for numbered units.
Showing the final result supplies the reckoning endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The runners are simply charging bodies.
changed_reading.after: The runners can also appear as prepared, counted, recurrent units whose final result will be gathered and shown.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it lets ash and weak sparks compete with the heroic rush; valid because the focus breath root contains scorched/ash images and the context supplies fire-making plus a later spark image. Downstream prose should frame it as a residue-counterimage, not as replacing the kinetic reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus breath word has a scorched-material underside that can end in ash.

activation_trace.role: Scorched wood anchors the heat-reading directly in the focus.
Ash supplies the humbling residue left after heat and motion spend themselves.
Latent fire emerging from a stick supplies ignition for the focus's scorched underside.
Striking fire supplies the practical source of sparks.
Tiny useless sparks supply a diminished counterimage to the charged oath energy.

changed_reading.before: The rush seems pure force and triumphal energy.
changed_reading.after: The rush can also leave a fragile residue: sparks flare, blacken, and collapse toward ash.

strongest_changes: 100:2 makes the focus breath/fire relation unavoidable: panting can become frictional ignition.
100:4-100:5 turn speed into trace and penetration: sound becomes dust, then dusted motion enters a gathered center.
100:6-100:11 reread the rushing scene as moral-forensic evidence, moving from external overdrive to inner appetite and later exposure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is unusually generative because both roots are branch-rich at different registers: one root gives running, trespass, counting, and return; the other gives breath, animal motion, scorch, darkening, and ash. The context does not settle this into one image but successively activates kinetic, material, social, moral, and forensic readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the primary referent should remain literal charging animals/agents or be carried mainly as a diagnostic image for the later human predicate.
How far to render the non-dominant count/return mappings before they become too branch-distant for ordinary commentary.
Whether the combustion-shadow should be kept as a major line or only as a contained outlier beside the more obvious spark sequence.
